content.short: bemo enables non-custodial liquid staking on TON, allowing users to earn rewards while keeping liquidity with as little as 1 TON.
content.description: bemo is the first non-custodial liquid staking protocol on TON. By staking with bemo, users earn staking rewards while preserving liquidity and maintaining access to their assets via stTON tokens. The platform lowers the entry barrier for TON staking, enabling participation with as little as 1 TON instead of the traditional 10,000 TON minimum, thereby democratizing access to staking rewards and DeFi opportunities on the TON blockchain.

resources.title: Intro to Liquidity Pools: Structure, Risks, and Rewards
resources.tldr: Starts from what a pool actually is at the contract level before touching returns, which is the right order. Impermanent loss is explained rather than mentioned in passing.

resources.title: How Liquid Staking Impacts Capital Efficiency
resources.tldr: Ordinary staking locks capital; liquid staking hands you a claim you can reuse elsewhere. Follows what that reuse does to your risk once the receipt token is leveraged.

resources.title: How Liquid Staking Helps Manage Risks in Crypto Investments
resources.tldr: Capital size tends to dictate strategy: small books chase growth, large ones want yield without lockup. Positions liquid staking against that split rather than as a universal answer.
